subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should a yielded cron parent with active descendants become a new public `deferred` status across persisted run history, Gateway protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and plugin SDK consumers?
rationale: The internal waiting behavior fixes a real bug, but choosing a new durable cross-surface status and its terminal, exit-code, and upgrade semantics requires product and compatibility ownership rather than inference from unit tests.

options.title: Adopt `deferred` publicly
options.body: Keep the new value, specify its terminal-handoff and CLI semantics, and require exact-head fresh-install and upgrade compatibility proof.

options.title: Keep waiting state internal
options.body: Preserve yielded-parent lifecycle and settlement behavior without expanding the public cron status union.

recommendation.title: Adopt `deferred` publicly
recommendation.body: Keep the new value, specify its terminal-handoff and CLI semantics, and require exact-head fresh-install and upgrade compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is his authorship of the lifecycle module boundaries that define yielded-parent state and settlement.
